gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Builds the 8-slot source array reused by many tests. Layout: [buffered, array, buffered, buffered, independent, buffered, array, independent] where `buffered` w
ADDED i3: GroupedRandomAccessSource reports the total length even after close().
ADDED i5: A WindowRandomAccessSource with offset 807 has no data before that position. Requesting bytes at position 196 (before the window) returns -1.
ADDED i6: Passing a negative buffer offset and negative length to get() returns -1.
ADDED i8: Reading a single byte at a negative position returns -1.
ADDED i9: Reading a single byte at position 0 from a zero-filled source returns 0.
ADDED i11: Reading bytes starting at position -1 returns -1.
ADDED i13: Requesting 4 bytes starting at position 4 in a 6-byte source returns 2 (only 2 remain).
ADDED i14: A WindowRandomAccessSource constructed with a negative length reports that negative value.
ADDED i15: Reading 5 bytes starting at position 5 into a 6-element destination array causes ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because the copy would write past index 5.
